questions.stem: In a design review, an analyst notes the evidence: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: Because it adds decorative adjectives to the title
Because it sets the font size of the title
Because it chooses which idea to foreground
Because it shortens the whole article

questions.explanation: A headline foregrounds selected information and guides attention; decoration or length alone do not determine salience.
